facts.fact: Togo First reports GUCE currently handles the electronic coordination of foreign-trade formalities and GUFORD the maritime and port formalities, and an order of 14 October 2026 will replace both with a single Port Community System at Lomé port, with no go-live date.

Interministerial order 011 of 14 October 2026 treats the GUCE foreign-trade single window as Togo's current principal system for goods formalities, with the GUFORD maritime single window beside it, until a Port Community System replaces both.
